'''September 2000 Pleasanton tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at KK's Kards and Komics, Pleasanton, CA on 17 September 2000. It is known from Alfred Dong's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1258">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-21-pleasonton-ca-9-17d1258/ pleasonton-ca-9-17], DeckTech (Alfred "ThaBraHmaBuL" Dong, 21 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-21-pleasonton-ca-9-17d1258/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 17 September 2000
* '''Site:''' KK's Kards and Komics, Pleasanton, CA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
